//: Story Phase 7: the Stenchmaster Entertainment System Mark II, built below decks during the returning Great Sharkstorm out of a turnip crate, the original's salvaged picture tube and whatever Garrick could prise off the ship. Its own art (bezel, back, power source), its own condition (under_construction until the startup), its own power and channel. It inherits the original's terrible knob panel. Like the original it is impossible: the back and the power source are crayon, string, a horseshoe and a lantern's glow. Nobody ever opens it, and nothing about it is a real procedure.

ses_mk2.name: The Stenchmaster Entertainment System Mark II
offComments: captain: It's off. The tubes are still faintly warm. It's a fruit crate, and it's warm.
garrick: It's resting between episodes, Captain.
captain: Dark glass in a turnip crate. A horseshoe on top. The knob on the string swings when the ship rolls.
captain: FINEST TURNIPS, it says on the side.
garrick: Was. It was finest turnips. Now it's finest television.

channels.title: Static
comments: captain: Snow.
garrick: Mark Two snow. Crisper.
captain: It's the same snow as the old one.
garrick: It's the same SKY, Captain. Different snow.
captain: Somewhere above us a shark lands, and the snow jumps.

channels.title: Potatoes
comments: captain: The man peeling potatoes. He's still at it.
garrick: He never stopped. Good to know some things don't change.
captain: ...He's on a different potato now.
garrick: Character development.

channels.title: A Fish
comments: captain: The fish.
garrick: The fish.
captain: At least it isn't a shark.
garrick: Not in HERE, Captain.

channels.title: The Frog Tax Man
comments: captain: Franklin.
garrick[delighted]: FRANKLIN.
captain: I'm not watching it.
garrick: Of course not, Captain.
Every pirate in the hold is sitting down. You are the only one standing: directly behind all of them, with the best view in the house.
captain: ...Has he found the receipts?
garrick[proud]: Shh.

channels.title: The Bling Bling King Show
channels.//: Story Phase 11: a channel nobody tuned. It turned up by itself the night of the Finger-Puller vote.
comments: captain: The shark. At a desk.
pete[annoyed]: Where does a shark GET a desk?
captain: It's still on.
garrick[offended]: It's very one-sided, Captain. There's never anyone on to speak for the OFFICE.

channels.title: The Stenchmaster Channel
channels.//: Story Phase 13: the bedroom set's channel, down the cable the long way round (the deck, a cannon, the main hatch).
comments: captain: The Stenchmaster Channel. Down here too.
jim[annoyed]: In my GALLEY.
captain: It doesn't smell, down here. Small mercies.
garrick[worried]: The Mark II hasn't got the vent, Captain. It's an older model.

wiring: captain: The back. SIGNAL (PROBABLY). DO NOT LICK. RECEPTION, with an arrow, to a horseshoe.
garrick: It's all labelled, Captain. That's professional.
captain: Copper going round and round and round. Into nothing.
garrick: Into the SIGNAL, Captain. Round is how signal likes it.
captain: There's a spoon taped to the inside.
powerSource: captain: The inside of the cabin-door lantern, a bottle of Frog Grog and the spare bell. Tied together with a garter.
garrick: Don't ask questions about the power source, Captain. It gets shy.
captain: The lantern's glowing. It isn't lit. It's just... glowing.
slap: garrick: Firmly. On the crate. Not the horseshoe. Never the horseshoe.
captain: I hit a turnip crate and it got better.
garrick: Mark Two responds to leadership.

lines: pete: It's doing the thing again!
garrick: Warm-up.
captain: It's rolling.
garrick: Slap the crate. NOT the horseshoe.
captain: That's smoke.
garrick: That's the turnips, Captain. Residual turnips.
gristle: It's going to go up!
garrick: It's going to go up a CHANNEL, Mister Gristle.

lookComments: captain: Half a television. A crate, a tube, a horseshoe, a great deal of string.
garrick: Three-quarters, Captain. The knob's coming.
captain: Nothing. Good. Keep it that way.

storm_static.//: Story Phase 10: inside the Great Sharkstorm, the horseshoe aerial knocked flat in the spin. On, but it gets nothing but snow whatever the channel, and now and then, for a frame, Franklin.
lookComments: captain: Snow. And in the snow, now and then, a frog.
garrick[worried]: The aerial, Captain. The aerial's been through a lot.

sauce_antenna.//: Story Phase 10, and after: a can of Spicy Stench Sauce jammed on the horseshoe aerial. It works. Nobody will say why.
lookComments: captain: A can of sauce on a horseshoe on a turnip crate.
pete[annoyed]: I hate that it works.

knobs.//: Story Phase 7 (chapter 40): Mark II inherits the original's panel, worse. Every wrong knob does something (louder, upside down, rolling, a shriek, a colour); none of them hurt; FROG MAYBE finds Franklin on the second try. Abstract knobs on the outside of a fictional box: nobody reaches inside it.
openLines: captain: Knobs. In crayon again. VOLUME?, UPSIDE, ROLLY, SHRIEK, COLOUR, SPOON, FROG MAYBE.
garrick: I kept the layout. People like what they know.

list.label: VOLUME?
lines: The static goes from loud to LOUD. Dust comes down off the deckhead.
bob[alarmed]: The SHARKS will hear it!
garrick: The sharks have their own problems, Bob.
Louder still. The crate rattles on its hinges.
pete[annoyed]: STOP TURNING THAT ONE!

list.label: UPSIDE
lines: The picture turns upside down. The snow falls upwards.
gristle: That's worse. I don't know how, but that's worse.
Right way up again. Probably.

list.label: ROLLY
lines: The picture starts to roll, over and over, like the ship.
hale[disgusted]: Please. I've only just got my stomach back.
The rolling stops. Hale breathes out.

list.label: SHRIEK
lines: A noise comes out of Mark II that has no business coming out of anything.
squawks[furious]: NO.
garrick: That one's labelled, Squawks. Fair warning.

list.label: COLOUR
lines: The snow goes green. Then a colour nobody has a name for.
bob[surprised]: Is that a colour?
garrick: It is now.

list.label: SPOON
lines: You turn the spoon. Nothing happens.
garrick: Fine tuning, Captain. It's very fine. You won't see it.

list.label: FROG MAYBE
lines: Something green moves in the snow. For a moment. Then it's gone.
garrick[alarmed]: AGAIN, Captain. AGAIN.

antenna.//: Story Phase 10 (chapter 93): the aerial, inside the Great Sharkstorm. Every adjustment gets a glimpse of something (the weather, a cooking programme, an advert, Franklin for a second); none of it holds. After three tries, the last idea turns up: the can of Spicy Stench Sauce. It works. No wrong answer is a dead end.
openLines: captain: The aerial. A horseshoe, a cotton reel, a fork, a lot of copper wire. All of it flat.
garrick[worried]: Gently, Captain. She's delicate. She's been through a STORM.

list.label: BEND IT BACK
lines: You bend the horseshoe upright. The weather, somewhere sunny, for a second. Then snow.
bob: Sunny. Somewhere's sunny.
Upright again. A little sun with a face on it waves. Snow.

list.label: TWIST THE FORK
lines: You twist the fork. A man peeling potatoes, calm as anything. Gone.
jim[annoyed]: He's got a kitchen that stays still. I hate him.

list.label: WIGGLE THE WIRE
lines: You wiggle the copper wire. An advert for Pond Soap, very cheerful, very brief.
gristle: Even the adverts are getting more signal than us.

list.label: FLIP THE HORSESHOE
lines: You flip the horseshoe round. FRANKLIN. For one second, Franklin. Then snow.
garrick[alarmed]: HE'S IN THERE, Captain! He's trying to get through!

list.label: SLAP IT
lines: You slap the side of the crate. The snow gets snowier.
squawks[smug]: Good slap. Bad idea.

list.label: THE SAUCE CAN
lines: You jam the can of Spicy Stench Sauce onto the horseshoe.
doneLines: The snow parts like a curtain. A frog in a tie, perfectly clear.
captain: I am not acknowledging that.

late_night.//: Story Phase 11 (chapter 109): the Mark II switched itself on, and won't go off. Every knob does something to the picture or the sound, and the programme carries on regardless; after four other tries the MASTER SWITCH turns up under the crate lid, and it works. No wrong answer is a dead end.
openLines: captain: Knobs. FLIP, STRETCH, WORSE SOUND, MUTE. No OFF.
garrick[businesslike]: There's no OFF, Captain. Off is a state of mind.

list.label: FLIP
lines: The picture turns upside down. The shark at its desk is upside down. It is still smug upside down.
bob[surprised]: It's STILL talking.
Right way up again. Unfortunately.

list.label: STRETCH
lines: The picture goes wide and squat. The shark is now as wide as the desk. The desk is as wide as the galley.
ned: That's worse. That's worse in a way I can't explain.
Back to the right shape. The shark adjusts its tie.

list.label: WORSE SOUND
lines: The sound goes low and slow and drags. The laugh track sounds like whales.
jim: It sounds like it's talking from the bottom of a well.
pete: I'd prefer that.
Normal speed again. The whales go.

list.label: MUTE
lines: Silence! Blessed... the shark keeps talking. Silently. You can read its lips. You wish you couldn't.
garrick[offended]: Turn it back UP, Captain, I'm missing the Court bit!

list.label: MASTER SWITCH
lines: Under the crate's lid, behind the horseshoe, a big brass switch you've never noticed: MASTER.
doneLines: The picture folds down to a dot. The dot goes out.
